# Saudi Mecha Robot (نادي سعودي ميكا روبوت / サウジ・メカ・ロボット)

> Saudi Mecha Robot is an independent hobby club founded in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia in {{ site.founded }}. It focuses on Gundam, Grendizer, Super Robot anime and Japanese culture, and brings together plamodel (Gunpla) and figure enthusiasts through group build challenges, beginner workshops and a member gallery.

- Also known as: Gundam_Saudi, نادي سعودي ميكا روبوت, サウジ・メカ・ロボット
- Founded: {{ site.founded }}, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
- Languages: Arabic (primary), English, Japanese
- Celebrated its second anniversary on 28 August 2026
